response.original_title: {{Norwegian-FAQs}} Can I Add a Passenger to My Existing Norwegian Reservation?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Norwegian Cruise, you must call Norwegian directly at +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent. To add someone to an existing room on a Norwegian Cruise, you must call Norwegian customer service directly or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Reach out to Norwegian Cruises at +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or call your original booking agent. To add someone to a room on a Norwegian Cruise, you must call Norwegian Cruise Customer Service directly at +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor. You cannot add a passenger online or through the mobile app. Your stateroom must physically support an extra person via a sofa bed, third berth, or Pullman setup. If your room is at maximum capacity, you may need to upgrade to a larger room.
